passages.excerpt_preview: The edicts were also written in Aramaic and Greek, bearing witness to Ashoka’s projection of power westwards.

passages.locator: Indian flag adopted at independence in 1947
passages.excerpt_preview: In the modern construction of India Ashoka has played a great role as a unifying figure: the Indian flag adopted at independence in 1947 has the Wheel of Ashoka as its central symbol.
Ashoka seems to have sponsored religion in general and probably Buddhism in particular, as documented by his inscriptions.

passages.locator: Buddhist traditions preserve a plethora of legends
passages.excerpt_preview: Buddhist traditions preserve a plethora of legends of Ashoka; much remains to be analysed to distinguish real history and legend.

passages.locator: earliest examples of writing in India
passages.excerpt_preview: The earliest examples of writing in India are found in his edicts, and Brahmi is the forefather of modern Indian and several South and Southeast Asian writing systems.
